rationale.oral_launch_share: Research mode was 40%. Later-oral analogues in the evidence register launched well below parity: Attruby about 18-20% of new prescriptions, Scemblix 23% in first line. 30% keeps the 60% mature share and the five-year ramp; 20-45% prior.
rationale.ir_retention: Research mode was 90%, which the model audit describes as a forecast, not a measurement; the 91% repeat-dispensing statistic is not annual continuation and the comparator prevention persistence is 61% at twelve months. 85% with a 78-92% prior.
